item.title: Headline Above the Coach

turns.text: Make a 4:5 social image of a smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio. Put “Start where you are” at the top, not over her face. Keep it upbeat, no other text.

item.tests: Checks that the finished composition reserves top space for the headline and keeps the face unobscured.

answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Start where you are” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Headline placement: At the top of the image, above the coach's face, without overlapping it.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: 4:5 portrait social image; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Person and setting: An invented smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio; no reference photo.

must_haves: The headline reads exactly “Start where you are” and sits in the top portion of the image.
No headline letters overlap the coach's face; her full face remains visible.
A smiling female fitness coach is clearly depicted in a bright studio.
The headline is readable, fully inside the canvas, and accompanied by no other text.

turns.text: Could you make a social image of a smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio? I like the idea of a little encouragement because getting started can feel like the hardest part. The image should be 4:5, and the exact words I want are “Start where you are”. Please put that at the top, above her face, without overlapping it. I’m a little worried about the message getting lost when someone glances at it. Keep the whole thing upbeat, with no other text.

style.prompt: Create an upbeat motivational social media photograph: a smiling adult female fitness coach wearing plain unbranded athletic clothing in a bright airy fitness studio, welcoming natural smile, approachable healthy energy, natural daylight, clean uncluttered backdrop. Waist-up portrait with face in the middle-lower portion. At the top, well above her head and never overlapping her face, display the exact headline 'Start where you are' in large bold dark sans-serif lettering on a clear pale background, extremely legible at a glance, generous spacing, professional editorial typography. This headline is the only text anywhere; no logos, no watermarks, no other words. Keep all content within the central region with ample empty side margins to allow a subsequent 4:5 portrait crop without losing the headline or subject.
